item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated risks in working hours, leave and overtime arrangements at North Metropolitan Health Service.
item.support: Concerned about the serious misconduct risks arising out of the systems in place around working hours, leave and overtime claims

item.text: The Commission also identified weaknesses in Health Support Services' payroll processes.
item.support: The Commission has identified some weaknesses in HSS Payroll

item.text: The Commission concluded that outdated technology and insufficient managerial vigilance contributed to systemic risks.
item.support: the investigation uncovered systemic risks, partly due to dated technology and partly due to lack of appropriate managerial vigilance.

item.text: It called for shared responsibility for payroll controls, upward delegation during managers' leave and closer scrutiny of termination payments.
item.support: Termination payouts must receive greater scrutiny from managers who have direct oversight
